opening.argument: The speaker announces two winners, each awarded a $50 Sephora gift card, and says she will send e-gift certificates after verifying their channels and subscriptions. Her request that the winners message her on YouTube is expressly tied to confirming that she is dealing with their actual channels. Those are the stated steps of a creator-run giveaway for viewers, not a demand for payment. The video describes no additional request for private data, deception, or loss. On the evidence presented, the contact and verification request is part of delivering the announced rewards.

citations.quote: I've decided to pick two winners
you both have won a $50 gift card to Sephora
make sure you message me on my YouTube channel so I can verify that it's actually your channel
I can verify your channels, your subscriptions, and then I can send you guys your, um, your e-gift certificates
